title: Structural Engineer
description:
Do you enjoy being a part of successful team

Would you like to work on industry leading projects?

Join our team

Bringing cutting-edge physical and digital technologies together to create oilfield equipment is the beating heart of our work. Devising smarter systems that control and monitor oil and gas extraction, our subsea and flexible pipe capabilities are industry leading. Our team provides support for customer operations to ensure continuity for production.

Partner with the best

The Structural Engineering is part of the solution scope for the flexible pipe business and deals with the development of ancillary equipment necessary for logistics, installation, and operation of the system. The activities consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the user's needs. The discipline executes a robust process of design, finite element analysis, optimization of ancillaries, and creation of alternate design concepts, aiming efficiency, smart design, productivity and cost saving.

As a Structural Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Perform Finite Element Analysis (FEA) for flexible pipeline equipment and components.
  • Participate in applied R&D projects and equipment design improvements.
  • To develop, check the design and layout of all components and systems like end fitting/ancillaries that compose the flexible pipe systems.
  • Perform assigned technical tasks, including structural analysis, calculations, design, verification, and study activities.
  • Collaborate with other Project Specialists and Designers on problem solving.
  • Collaborate in technical activities performed internally and externally to ensure compliance with technical requirements and adherence to established deadlines.
  • Create and propose process improvements, as well as provide technical assistance and guide the team.
  • Requiring understanding of a concepts, methods, and procedures

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Civil Engineering or Naval Engineering
  • Hold active CREA
  • At least 3 years' experience with finite element analysis
  • Advanced English level
  • Have good experience in Engineering/ Technology
  • Experience with AutoCAD, Solidworks, MathCAD and Excel.
  • Have effective problem identification and solution skills.
  • Have proven analytical and organizational ability.
  • Mandatory: Strength on ANSYS

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working from MON-FRI, 7am to 4pm (Flexibility to do 1 day per week "home office")

Location: RETIC – Cidade Universitária (Fundão) – Rio de Janeiro

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

About Us

With operations in over 120 countries, we provide better solutions for our customers and richer opportunities for our people. As a leading partner to the energy industry, we're committed to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 and we're always looking for the right people to help us get there. People who are as passionate as we are about making energy safer, cleaner and more efficient.

Join Us

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company with a global reach and exciting services and clients? Come join us and grow with a team of people who will energize and inspire you

A Baker Hughes Company prioriza oportunidades iguais para todos os candidatos. Todas as nossas vagas são destinadas também a pessoas portadoras de deficiência. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams on demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world's largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

About the client

Our client is a leading global consulting firm that delivers transformation programs for companies worldwide. They develop internal tools and client-facing web applications using modern full-stack development and Generative AI, focusing on automation, smarter decision-making, and enhanced user experiences.

About the role

We're hiring Full-Stack Engineers (Python/React/GenAI) to join multiple production AI initiatives. You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary consulting team to build scalable web applications and integrate GenAI capabilities into business workflows.

This role is a great fit for engineers who like owning features end-to-end, collaborating with stakeholders, and shipping in a fast-moving environment. It's also important to note: general full-stack experience alone isn't enough. You'll be expected to contribute both to new builds from scratch and to improving and expanding existing systems — including integrating GenAI features that will be used in production.

What success looks like:

  • Ship production-grade features end-to-end using Python (Django preferred) and React, including well-structured APIs and reliable deployments.
  • Deliver GenAI features in production (LLM interactions, workflow automation, data enrichment, RAG) with practical guardrails and evaluation.
  • Improve performance and maintainability by identifying bottlenecks, strengthening service boundaries, and contributing to CI/CD quality.
  • Collaborate effectively with distributed, cross-functional teams across multiple initiatives and geographies.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize backend services using Python (Django preferred; Flask/FastAPI acceptable).
  • Build responsive, maintainable front-end interfaces using React.
  • Integrate Generative AI capabilities into existing and new applications (e.g., LLM interactions, workflow automation, data enrichment, RAG).
  • Design and implement REST APIs that connect front-end, back-end, and AI services.
  • Assist in testing, debugging, and deployment using modern CI/CD practices.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Important to note:

  • Location: Brazil-based candidates ONLY (São Paulo & Rio areas)
  • Work model: Remote, with expected onsite visits a few times per month.
  • Type: Contract, 40h/week.
  • Duration: 6-12 months initially, with long-term engagement.
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship.

Requirements


Must have:

  • Experience of at least 3 years in the domain.
  • Solid hands-on understanding of Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI or similar).
  • High level of front-end familiarity with React (production web apps).
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating GenAI solutions in production (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, LangChain, embeddings, vector DB, RAG).
  • Master the fundamentals of RESTful API/Service integration design.
  • Experience with databases: SQL and/or NoSQL.
  • Knowledge of cloud environments: AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of MLOps workflows (model evaluation, monitoring, prompt/versioning, deployment patterns).
  • Experience in consulting or enterprise settings.

Benefits

  • Why consider this opportunity?
    You'll get access to Toptal's global network, including opportunities with Fortune 500 and other enterprise clients.

  • You'll have flexibility to choose projects that match your goals — part-time or full-time, short-term or long-term (based on matching and availability).

  • There's a potential path to direct employment with the client later.
  • The client may provide a Windows laptop.

title: tutor educacional
description:
Ambiente

Somos a Revvo, uma das principais empresas de aprendizagem corporativa do Brasil, e estamos aqui para quebrar padrões e ajudar todas as empresas a concretizarem seu potencial por meio do desenvolvimento das suas pessoas. Isso é o que chamamos de revolução de aprendizagem

Temos mais de 10 anos de história e contamos com mais de 200 REVVOlucionários espalhados por todo o Brasil.

Temos espaço para talentos com grande capacidade de adaptação, espírito colaborativo e foco em qualidade e resultado. Sabemos também que a diversidade é fundamental, por isso, estamos sempre evoluindo para manter um ambiente de trabalho seguro e inclusivo para todos.

Se identifica com o nosso jeito de ser? Então venha com a gente e faça parte da REVVOlução da aprendizagem.

MISSÃO/ RESUMO:

O tutor educacional atua como elo direto entre o participante e a proposta pedagógica da solução educacional . É responsável por acompanhar o percurso formativo, responder dúvidas, avaliar atividades, mediar interações nos fóruns, incentivar a reflexão e promover o desenvolvimento das competências previstas. Sua atuação está alinhada aos princípios da mediação pedagógica de cada solução.

FORMAÇÃO/ CURSOS/ CERTIFICAÇÕES NECESSÁRIAS:

  • Formação superior completa, preferencialmente em Pedagogia, Educação, Psicologia,
  • Comunicação, Biblioteconomia,Letras, Tecnologias Educacionais ou áreas afins.
  • Desejável especialização em Educação a Distância, Design Instrucional, Tutoria Online
  • ou Mediação Pedagógica. Conhecimentos sólidos em metodologias ativas e ferramentas de EAD.
  • Desejável conhecimentos em DI e criações de conteúdos;
  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Experiência no cargo de Consultor de Educação Digital ou similar.

COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS:

  • Função Motivacional:

Desenvolver estratégias de ensino-aprendizagem que impactem positivamente nas

atitudes e emoções dos participantes, promovendo comprometimento, motivação,

engajamento e senso de pertencimento.

  • Função Acompanhadora:

Manter relação constante com o participante, apoiando sua permanência e autonomia no

percurso.

  • Função Orientadora:

Apoiar o desenvolvimento de competências com base em feedbacks personalizados e

construtivos.

  • Função Comunicadora:

Dialogar com clareza, empatia e assertividade, promovendo acolhimento e engajamento.

  • Função Integradora:

Colaborar com mediação e supervisão na gestão pedagógica do curso.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:

  • Mediar a aprendizagem por meio da interação qualificada nos fóruns pedagógicos
  • (canal institucional de atendimento);
  • Esclarecer dúvidas dos participantes sobre conteúdos, atividades, recursos e
  • processos da trilha certificadora;
  • Estimular a reflexão e a aplicação prática dos conteúdos, com base nas diretrizes da solução educacional;
  • Avaliar atividades com foco formativo, considerando os critérios definidos no plano pedagógico;
  • Registrar interações, dificuldades recorrentes e boas práticas no canal de acompanhamento institucional;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de participação, engajamento e desempenho dos participantes;
  • Comunicar à mediação e à supervisão situações que demandem intervenção pedagógica ampliada;
  • Utilizar linguagem acolhedora, clara e orientada por competências;
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com a equipe pedagógica.
  • Acompanhar e interagir em aulas síncronas.
  • Apoiar encontros síncronos, como webinares e ações de ancoragem, quando previstos no plano pedagógico da solução, atuando de forma articulada com a mediação e a supervisão.
  • Utilizar as ferramentas da Microsoft, como Planner, Lists, Excel, Forms etc.;
  • Garantir a padronização das pastas e arquivos.

Fundada em 1977 como "Cardiolab", atualmente conta com 75 hospitais próprios e 3 sob gestão, além de 55 clínicas oncológicas, nos estados do RJ, SP, MG, PE, BA, MA, SE, CE, AL, PB, PR, MS, PA e DF.

Gerencia diferentes marcas, tendo presença mais marcante no Rio de Janeiro, com a marca "D'Or"; em SP, com "São Luiz"; em PE, com "Esperança"; no DF, com "Santa Luzia" e "Santa Helena"; no MA, com "UDI"; na BA, com "São Rafael"; em SE, com "São Lucas"; no PR, com "Santa Cruz"; em MG, com "Biocor", em MS, com "Proncor", em PB, com "Nossa Senhora das Neves", em CE com "São Carlos", além da marca premium "Star" nos estados do RJ, SP e DF.

Em 23 de dezembro de 2022, a proposta de valor da Rede D'Or foi reforçada significativamente com a consumação da combinação de negócios com a SulAmérica – a maior seguradora do Brasil e uma das maiores operadoras de saúde do país. Com atuação nos segmentos de seguro saúde e odonto, vida e acidentes pessoais, gestão de ativos e previdência privada, a SulAmérica conta com mais de 4 mil pessoas colaboradoras e possui mais de 7 milhões de clientes distribuídos por todo Brasil.

Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.

Se você é uma pessoa qualificada, de perfil inovador e sintonizada com o que há de mais atual em sua área de atuação, junte-se à nossa equipe.

Oferecemos mais que vagas de trabalho, oferecemos oportunidades para você fazer a diferença.

description:
Você está pronto para alçar voo em um setor de aviação dinâmico e de ritmo acelerado? title: Analista de Engenharia Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga
A Aegea
Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.
Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.
Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.
A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.
Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Revisar e acompanhar a elaboração de diagnósticos, projetos executivos e estudos internos de estações de tratamento de água e esgoto (memoriais de cálculo, fluxogramas de processo, layouts, estimativas de OPEX, folhas de dados, entre outros);
Realizar cálculos de verificação e avaliação da capacidade das principais unidades e equipamentos de ETAs e ETEs, por vezes elaborando relatórios e memoriais de cálculo;
Executar visitas técnicas para acompanhamento e suporte às atividades relacionadas aos estudos e projetos desenvolvidos.
Executar atividades de engenharia nas áreas de projetos, obras, planejamento, manutenção, operação, produção, tratamento e disposição final dos sistemas de saneamento;
Apoiar na realização de diagnósticos e estudos de viabilidade técnica e ambiental;
Apoiar na elaboração de projetos de redes de água e de esgotos, drenagem, saneamento e bombeamento;
Elaborar e avaliar relatórios, planilhas e gráficos da área, compilando dados para auxiliar em uma prévia análise gerencial; preencher e emitir documentos e solicitações internas da área, de acordo com normas e critérios definidos;
Prestar atendimento a clientes e fornecedores, solucionando dúvidas, fornecendo informações e orientações ou direcionando às pessoas indicadas.
Requisitos e qualificações
Graduação em engenharia sanitária/ambiental ou engenharia química;
Conhecimento intermediário em Excel;
Experiência com aspectos de tratamento de água, esgoto ou efluentes durante a graduação (pesquisa, estágio, voluntariado) serão considerados diferenciais;
Experiência com reuso, esgoto e água e seus dimensionamentos
Informações adicionais
Assistência médica;
Assistência odontológica;
Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
Seguro de vida;
Vale transporte;
Gympass;
Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
Kit office.
Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta
A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.
Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Senior Manager, Special Events
description:
Department: Events & Entertainment
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
Reporting to the Head of Special Events, the Senior Special Events Manager will serve as a senior leader within the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027 organization. This role is a pivotal member of the Local Organizing Structure, working in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Project Team, internal functional areas, Host Cities, Commercial Affiliates, Government Authorities, and other key stakeholders to deliver exceptional, world-class event experiences that elevate the tournament's global impact.
Role Purpose: The Senior Special Events Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, creative development, operational execution, and overall management of all official FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027 special events. The role ensures seamless, high-quality delivery aligned with FIFA's brand standards, commercial objectives, and global audience expectations.
Impact & Scope: The Senior Special Events Manager will play a critical role in shaping some of the most visible and globally broadcast moments of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027. From milestone launches to the Final Draw, this position directly contributes to the tournament's international perception, commercial success, and legacy in Brazil.
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong strategic vision, exceptional organizational and leadership skills, creative excellence, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast-paced, and multicultural environment.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Strategic Event Planning & Delivery
Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of major tournament-related events, including but not limited to:
Oficial Dinner
Final Draw
Brand Launch
Mascot Launch
Team Workshop
Volunteers Kick-Off Event
Guest activities, when required
Coordination of Legends Matches
Participation in pre-match ceremonies
Additional milestone and stakeholder events throughout the tournament lifecycle
Develop comprehensive event strategies, timelines, and delivery frameworks to ensure consistent quality, innovation, and alignment with FIFA's global positioning.
2. Creative Direction & Experience Design
Drive the creative vision and thematic development of each event in alignment with FIFA brand guidelines.
Oversee event concepts, production design, show flow, staging, entertainment, and guest experience.
Ensure all events reflect the prestige, inclusivity, and global significance of the FIFA Women's World Cup.
3. Operational & Logistical Oversight
Manage all operational aspects including venue selection, supplier procurement, production management, accreditation, guest services, protocol, and security coordination.
Ensure integrated planning across broadcast, marketing, communications, hospitality, and competition functions.
Implement detailed contingency and risk management plans to guarantee flawless delivery.
4. Budget & Financial Management
Develop, monitor, and control event budgets across multiple initiatives.
Optimize resource allocation while maintaining premium standards.
Manage vendor contracts and ensure cost efficiency, compliance, and financial transparency.
5. Stakeholder & Partner Coordination
Serve as the primary liaison for internal departments, Host Cities, commercial partners, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations related to special events.
Coordinate with the FIFA Zurich Project Team to ensure alignment with global event standards and reporting structures.
Manage protocol requirements and high-profile guest engagement including FIFA leadership, participating member associations, VIPs, and media.
6. Team Leadership & Management
Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary project team across different FIFA Functional Areas, fostering collaboration, accountability, and high performance.
Oversee external agencies and production partners, ensuring clear deliverables and performance standards.
Build a positive team culture aligned with FIFA values.
YOUR PROFILE
Education
A Master's degree (MBA) in Event Management, Sports Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
Additional executive education in large-scale event production, leadership, or project management is advantageous.
Experience
Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in large-scale international event management, preferably within global sporting events, major entertainment productions, or multinational organizations.
Proven experience leading high-profile, broadcast-level events such as draws, ceremonies, gala dinners, launches, or government-level functions.
Demonstrated experience managing multi-million-dollar budgets and complex procurement processes.
Strong background in stakeholder management involving senior executives, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations.
Experience working in matrix organizations and collaborating with global headquarters or international governing bodies is highly desirable.
Previous experience within FIFA tournaments or comparable mega-events (e.g., Olympic Games, continental championships, global expos) is a strong advantage.
Skills & Competencies
Strategic & Operational Excellence
Strong ability to translate strategic objectives into comprehensive event delivery plans.
Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple large-scale initiatives simultaneously.
Advanced knowledge of event production, show calling, staging, audiovisual integration, and broadcast requirements.
Leadership & Team Management
Proven leadership capability with experience managing multidisciplinary teams and external agencies.
Ability to inspire, mentor, and drive high performance in fast-paced environments.
Strong decision-making skills under pressure.
Financial & Commercial Acumen
Solid budget planning, financial oversight, and cost-control expertise.
Understanding of sponsorship integration and brand alignment within event environments.
Communication & Stakeholder Engagement
Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.
Ability to manage high-level protocol and VIP relations with professionalism and discretion.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is highly desirable.
Personal Attributes
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and solutions-driven.
Resilient and adaptable in dynamic, multicultural environments.
Creative mindset with strong attention to brand experience and innovation.
High integrity and alignment with FIFA's values of inclusion, teamwork, and excellence.
Requiriments
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Junior Maintenance Technician
description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron's 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Your responsibilities:

  • In this position, the Service Technician will be responsible for carrying out service and maintenance tasks on turbochargers, working both at company facilities and at customer sites. In this role you will be responsible for performing service and maintenance on Turbochargers in Brazil.
  • The role provides specialized technical support, executing activities in accordance with Accelleron workflows, quality standards, and safety guidelines — ensuring superior customer experience and operational excellence.
  • Service Delivery: Performs Service tasks like disassembly, cleaning, inspection, measurement and assembly of different types of turbochargers, in accordance with work instructions, through the identification of technical problems, carrying out remote and in-person analyses at the Workshop and or in the field in various categories of vessels (ships, platforms, etc.) and thermoelectric plants. In the field it means by performing installation and commissioning, maintenance, repairs, updates, renovations and replacements, among others, meeting customer expectations and pre-established internal procedures.
  • Customer Approach: Contributes to customer satisfaction by executing Service work according to customer order and expectation Creates and maintains a good relationship with customers and understands their needs Identifies new sales opportunities and communicates them internally. Execute the repair according to instructions from service coordination
  • Materials & Supply: Coordinates, prepares and ensures that all materials, parts and equipment are available and at the appropriate quality for Service activities.
  • Documents & Reports: Prepares all documents and reports to be signed by the customer representative Reports work done in a timely manner and follows up when needed. Perform maintenance inspections and reports on turbochargers. Clean up parts and take pictures and measurements as requested by maintenance tool and process
  • Troubleshooting: Proactively identifies potential equipment failures and requests proactive corrective actions Troubleshoots equipment failure and makes recommendations to avoid repeating the problem in the future.
  • Operational Excellence Proactively identifies suggestions for product and quality improvement and communicates them further in the Accelleron organization Provides recommendations to management to improve operations and customer service.
  • Health, Safety, Environmental, Quality and Integrity: Applies safety rules and safe practices, environmental responsibilities as well as quality process. Reports unsafe practices and incidents.

Your background:

Education and Experience -

  • Technical training in Mechanics with an active CFT (Mechanical Technician Certificate);
  • Experience in maintenance and service of rotating machinery, engines (minimum 2 years), or preferable focus on working with turbochargers, large combustion engines, and/or mechanical technologies related to the maritime segment;
  • Preferable experience in mechanical assembly and disassembly, including the use of precision measuring instruments, hand tools, hydraulic and pneumatic tools, etc;
  • Preferably certified or experienced in lifting operations, overhead crane handling, and electric forklift, work at height, ensuring compliance with industrial safety standards;
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, Planner etc.);
  • Intermediate English;
  • Availability for national and international travel to execute services and training;
  • Active driver's license
  • Passport.

Core Competencies -

  • Familiarity in working within regulations and rules, following management guidelines;
  • Service and solution-oriented mindset, with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills;
  • Customer and results orientation
  • Responsibility, autonomy, and commitment to safety
  • Effective communication and teamwork.
  • Proven capability to perform well under emergency work demand.
  • Proactivity and continuous improvement mindset.

Job Conditions -

  • Flexibility to work outside of normal business hours
  • Available to travel: Required across Brazil neighboring countries (Uruguay, Paraguay, Bolivia, Chile, Peru, Argentina)

title: Especialista de Inteligência de Mercado
description:
Hydro Energia é uma empresa integrada de alumínio e energia com presença global, incluindo o Brasil. A Hydro Energia atua como uma comercializadora independente de energia elétrica, oferecendo serviços como gestão e otimização de portfólio de energia, consultoria regulatória e comercial, além de operações estruturadas no mercado de energia. No Brasil, a empresa tem escritórios em Belém e no Rio de Janeiro e é uma das maiores operadoras no mercado livre de energia no Norte do país. Aqui fazemos mais do que conectar energia: conectamos ideias, inovação e sustentabilidade. Nosso compromisso é construir um futuro energético mais eficiente, sustentável e inteligente.
O que oferecemos a você
Salário competitivo com o Mercado de Mineração e Metais, com um pacote abrangente de benefícios, garantindo que você seja recompensado pelas suas contribuições.
A oportunidade de se juntar a equipes diversas em uma empresa líder global em alumínio e energias renováveis que está mudando o jogo do alumínio.
Um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, criativo, com projetos globais e ambições sustentáveis.
Oportunidade de moldar a função e crescer na carreira por meio do desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal.
Você será parte de um negócio para o futuro juntando-se a nós em uma jornada transformadora.
O que você fará
Liderar tecnicamente e executar o processo de previsão de preços de energia de curto e médio prazo, promovendo sua evolução contínua e garantindo consistência metodológica, robustez analítica e qualidade dos resultados;
Atuar como assessor técnico da mesa de trading, fornecendo análises, cenários e recomendações para posicionamento e mitigação de riscos;
Acompanhar e participar ativamente de fóruns, reuniões e grupos de trabalho do Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS) e da Câmara de Comercialização de Energia Elétrica (CCEE) relacionados à formação do Preço de Liquidação das Diferenças (PLD), bem como monitorar regulação, notas técnicas e consultas públicas sobre o tema, antecipando potenciais impactos nos preços e nas estratégias comerciais da empresa;
Desenvolver, estruturar e evoluir processos automatizados, códigos e modelos internos associados à previsão de preços de curto e médio prazo (modelos principais e/ou satélites), assegurando atualização metodológica contínua, rastreabilidade e eficiência computacional;
Planejar e conduzir estudos complexos sobre formação de preços, avaliação de riscos e drivers estruturais do setor elétrico (expansão da geração, limites de transmissão, projeção de demanda, entre outros).
O que fará você ter sucesso?
Formação Acadêmica
Superior completo em Engenharia, Economia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas;
Desejável Mestrado em Otimização, Planejamento Energético, Modelagem Quantitativa ou áreas correlatas.
Conhecimentos e Habilidades
Experiência no mercado de energia elétrica;
Conhecimento dos modelos computacionais Newave, Decomp e Dessem;
Inglês avançado para conversação, escrita e leitura;
Pacote Office avançado;
Nível avançado em programação (necessário conhecimento de Python);
Nível avançado em ferramentas de Business Intelligence (preferencialmente Power BI);
Desejável conhecimento de técnicas avançadas de estatística e machine learning.
Perfil
Liderança técnica em modelagem e previsão de preços de energia;
Forte capacidade analítica e visão quantitativa;
Pensamento crítico para avaliação de modelos e premissas regulatórias;
Orientação a risco e suporte estratégico à mesa de trading;
Domínio de programação e automação de modelos (Python & BI);
Conhecimento aprofundado do setor elétrico e formação de PLD.
A Hydro valoriza diversas habilidades e perspectivas entre os empregados. Encorajamos todas as pessoas qualificadas a se inscreverem. Os perfis aderentes serão considerados independentemente de raça, religião, nacionalidade, etnia, idade, gênero, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência. Nós nos esforçamos para oferecer oportunidades iguais para que todos possam contribuir e ter sucesso conosco.
Atuação na Norsk Hydro (Rio de Janeiro/RJ ou Belém/PA), podendo ser uma localidade flexível.
Inscrições exclusivamente pelo site da Hydro. No ato da inscrição os Certificados de escolaridade deverão ser anexados. Para maiores informações, visite
Todas as oportunidades estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCD) e reabilitadas pelo INSS.

title: Civil Engineer
description:
This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
Result of ServiceThe Civil Engineer (Urban Infrastructures) reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/she shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Term of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.
Work LocationBelo Horizonte, Brazil
Expected durationSix (6) months, with possibility of renewal
Duties and ResponsibilitiesBackground The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient, and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, a Civil Engineer (Urban Infrastructures) is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Civil Engineer (Urban Infrastructures) reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Civil Engineer (Urban Infrastructures) will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Provide technical advice and support the execution of technical activities related to ongoing and new projects. b) Evaluate slope stabilization, retaining structures, and drainage projects. c) Supervise consultants for projects evaluation. d) Provide managerial support and coordinate the overall implementation of the project's work programme, including development, approval, and implementation of activities. e) Maintain close communication with counterparts and local partners, such as the governments, civil society organizations, universities, and private sectors, under supervision. f) Perform technical, administrative, and management activities to ensure that projects meet the objectives in terms of deadlines, budget, and quality. g) Provide appropriate technical support to implement activities related to the following areas: i. Capacity building and development. ii. Collection, production, analysis and management of data, information, and urban indicators. iii. Public policies. iv. Strategic and project planning, monitoring, and implementation. v. SDGs for localization and implementation of the New Urban Agenda. vi. Social mobilization and participation. vii. Effective advocacy, monitoring, and partnership. h) Provide information for the systematization and exchange of successful practices and experiences with other offices in the region and with headquarters divisions. i) Conduct technical activities to ensure that projects meet deadlines and quality objectives. j) Inputs for the identification and mitigation of projects' risks, including relevant challenges or omissions and other situations that may affect the development and implementation of projects. k) Attend meetings and conferences promoted by UN-Habitat partners. l) Document expert group meetings, forums, consultations, training events, and other activities related to the planning, development, and implementation of ongoing and new projects. m) Prepare reports to partners, internal reports, etc. at various stages of the projects. n) Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisor. o) Participate in missions as requested. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Civil Engineer (Urban Infrastructures) will provide technical advice and support the execution of activities related to the project. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.
Qualifications/special skillsEducation Required:
Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Geotechnical Engineering (Slope Stabilization and Retaining Structures) or Sanitary Engineering is required, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related fields is required. Work experience:
A minimum of six (6) years of progressively responsible experience on urban related themes in Brazil is required.
Experience in drainage or slope containment projects is required.
Experience in nature-based solutions for drainage or slope containment projects is required.
Experience in sustainable urbanization for informal settlements is required.
Experience in project/programme management is required.
Experience in social housing policies, plans, and projects is desirable.
Experience in earthmoving, geometric and pavement projects is desirable.
Experience in budget for urban infrastructure projects is desirable.
Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
Good computer skills in Windows, Word, Excel, Outlook, and Web search engines are required.
Good handling of technological tools and use of software and online platforms is desirable.
Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competencies
Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.
Additional InformationTravel details: Applicable The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration LICA 3. UNOPS Salary Scale. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted into the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. title: Analista de Gestão de Riscos Pleno
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA
A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).
Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.
Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.
Se você quer fazer parte da nossa companhia e se tornar um de nossos talentos, saiba que estamos com uma oportunidade em aberto para Analista de Gestão de Riscos Pleno, localizada em Rio de Janeiro/RJ, em modelo presencial.
Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente
RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS
Responsabilidades e Atribuições
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Gestão de Riscos para realizar a gestão dos riscos operacionais dos Projetos de Capital da empresa, do portfólio da Vice-Presidência de Engenharia - VEE. A atuação se dará durante todo o ciclo de vida do contrato, desde a captação de oportunidades no Pipeline até o encerramento do projeto.
Na área de Engenharia, essa posição irá atuar de maneira transversal junto às equipes internas das demais diretorias, especialmente em implantação, onde estão alocados contract managers e responsáveis por acompanhar os riscos. Junto às demais Vice-Presidências da empresa, a função atuará de forma integrativa ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos contratos, garantindo comunicação fluida e tomadas de decisão multidisciplinar.
Essa posição tem como objetivo principal melhorar a previsibilidade e assertividade dos resultados do portfólio, através da predição das tendências identificadas na gestão de riscos.
Responsabilidades
Estandarização de Processos: garantir que o processo de Gestão de Riscos seja seguido e contribuir para adequação às necessidades da VEE sempre que necessário.
Gerenciamento dos Riscos: identificação, análise, avaliação e tratamento dos riscos presentes em um determinado ambiente, de forma a minimizar as vulnerabilidades, maximizar as oportunidades e manter ou fortalecer os pontos fortes deste ambiente
Gestão de interesses das vice-presidências envolvidas: trabalhar com níveis hierárquicos adequados, garantindo atendimento das necessidades operacionais e estratégicas das demais áreas.
Monitoramento e Controle: coordenar e garantir que as ações de monitoramento necessárias sejam realizadas pelas equipes técnicas (desde simples revisões até reassessments dos contratos), atuando em conjunto com os gestores do contrato e o planejamento e controle para reavaliação dos valores de contingência.
Gestão da Informação: consolidar informações sobre os riscos nos projetos do portfólio, monitorando e controlando, através das equipes técnicas, o grau de severidade de cada um desses projetos, tanto qualitativa quanto quantitativamente;
Educação no tema Riscos: apoiar o pessoal envolvido na Gestão de Riscos Operacionais dos diversos projetos no aprofundamento do conhecimento na disciplina e como a mesma se relaciona na gestão da carteira.
REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS
Requisitos e Qualificações
Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração ou afins;
Conhecimento e experiência em gestão de riscos de projetos e/ou contratos;
Habilidade de comunicação fluida, criação de sinergia entre grupos de trabalho, capacidade de síntese de alto volume de informação, visão sistêmica.
Diferenciais
Conhecimento e/ou experiência envolvendo: formação de preço/orçamento, gestão de custos;
Certificações e/ou cursos em gestão de riscos ou envolvendo o tema.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Benefícios
Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. Alguns dos benefícios que disponibilizamos estão disponíveis abaixo:

title: Manager, Volunteer System
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department's main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in-line with FIFA's data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision-making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct "Train-the-Trainer" sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost-effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close-out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross-functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master's in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large-scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi-stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community-building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

title: Gerente de Turno
description:
A equipe da Amazon Logística está em busca de um(a) Gerente de Turno da Noite para se juntar à equipe da AMZL Brasil em nossa Delivery Station de Rio de Janeiro-RJ.
Como Gerente De Turno, Você Será Responsável Pela Operação Noturna Em Uma Estação De Entrega, Fornecendo Liderança Para Líderes De Equipe, Operadores e Prestadores De Serviços De Entrega, Gerenciando Relacionamentos e Desempenho De Agências Externas. Você Trabalhará Em Um Ambiente Altamente Colaborativo Que é Mais Semelhante a Uma Start-up Do Que a Uma Grande Empresa. A Atitude Adotada é Que Nenhuma Ideia é Uma Má Ideia e As Melhores Ideias São Aquelas Que Devem Ser Testadas e Experimentadas. Você Precisará Prosperar e Entregar Resultados Em Um Ambiente Ambíguo, Rápido e Dinâmico. Se Você Tem Um Histórico Focado Na Qualidade e Obcecado Pelo Cliente, Que Carrega Consigo a Experiência De Trabalhar Em Um Ambiente Dinâmico, Em Constante Mudança e Ambíguo, Adoraríamos Ouvir Sua Opinião. A Função Envolve
Estar baseado em um de nossos postos de entrega, no turno da noite. A Amazon opera 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, portanto, o trabalho em turnos fará parte dessa função, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
Supervisão da operação que foca na entrega de pedidos da Amazon direto aos clientes
Apoiar sua equipe de líderes operacionais na gestão diária do posto de entrega. Isso incluirá alocação de mão de obra, liderança de reuniões, atribuição de tarefas e comunicação com fornecedores internos e externos.
Trabalhar com KPIs como On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success e melhorar o atendimento ao cliente.
Pensar analiticamente sobre gerenciamento de projetos com atenção aos detalhes, capacidade de influenciar os outros e habilidades organizacionais excepcionais.
Ser obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para gerar melhorias.
Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal. Utilizando habilidades excepcionais de resolução de problemas e comunicação para influenciar o público comercial e técnico.
Fornecer suporte diário durante a implantação/implementação de novos sistemas/processos e coletar feedback.
Mapeamento de requisitos de negócios, entendimento de processos de negócios, estudo e análise de fluxos de trabalho e desenho de soluções.
Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir operações normais do dia a dia. Garantir que os associados tenham as ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
Comunicar métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos de Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience within a manufacturing or production environment
Experience with performance metrics and process improvement and Lean techniques
Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English
Preferred Qualifications
Speak, write, and read fluently in English
Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or experience in Engineering, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines, or experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. title: Technical Support Lead
description:
About Canals

Canals is a fully remote, profitable startup transforming the industrial supply chain ($10T industry) with AI. Our platform seamlessly integrates with the systems distributors already use, automating tedious tasks and reducing failure points in moving physical goods across the globe.

We're a 70-person team (~45 in engineering), located across North and South America.

The Role

We're launching a new product and hiring a Technical Support Lead to build and scale the support function for our new offering. You'll define workflows, shape customer communication standards, and lead a small team of Support Agents while collaborating with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success.

This is a hands-on role where you'll balance leadership with execution — mentoring your team, troubleshooting complex issues, and building scalable processes to maintain our 1-minute average first response time. You'll work across our multi-product ecosystem, supporting both SaaS and mobile experiences, and help ensure smooth integrations as we expand into new product lines. If you love building structure from scratch, guiding others, and partnering across teams to make new technology successful, this is your chance to have an outsized impact.

What You'll Do

  • Build and lead the technical support function for a new product line — from first customers to scale.

  • Manage and mentor a small team of Technical Support Agents, ensuring quality, consistency, and responsiveness.

  • Partner with Engineering and Product to triage, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues across SaaS and mobile products.

  • Establish and refine SLAs, escalation paths, and operational workflows that scale with growth.

  • Monitor and report on key support KPIs, maintaining our 1-minute first response time.

  • Document internal processes, build knowledge bases, and streamline communication between teams.

  • Serve as the escalation point for technically advanced or high-priority issues.

What You'll Bring

  • Typically, 4+ years of experience in technical support or support engineering for SaaS products.

  • Hands-on familiarity with multi-product environments — web and mobile platforms, APIs, and integrations.

  • Strong understanding of APIs, SQL, and modern web application troubleshooting.

  • Prior experience mentoring or leading a support or solutions team.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to explain complex topics to non-technical users.

  • Proven ability to build and optimize support processes, SLAs, and escalation workflows.

  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving, early-stage environment.

Bonus Points

  • You've supported the launch of a new product or defined early support operations for emerging offerings.

  • You have project management experience or familiarity with agile workflows.

  • You're comfortable using tools like Postman, Zendesk, and FullStory for debugging and analysis.

  • You've worked with non-technical customers in industrial, logistics, or distribution sectors.

  • You've partnered with Product and Engineering on mobile app support, release testing, or QA.

Why Join Canals

  • We're profitable: stability without the chaos of venture pivots.

  • Real-world impact: your work improves global supply chains, saving customers time and reducing waste.

  • Strong engineering culture: we invest in quality and documentation to keep moving fast sustainably.

  • Culture of ownership: moving fast while putting quality first

  • Remote-first, flexible work environment across North and South America.

  • Stellar product-market fit with tons of customer love

  • All star team with diverse backgrounds to collaborate with and learn from

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Mixmax is the #1 product helping Revenue teams to become automatically proactive by eliminating busywork for a flawless customer experience

The Opportunity


We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer who wants high ownership: leading projects end-to-end, improving how services are built and operated, and creating paved paths that reduce toil across engineering. This role can be based in LATAM or Europe.

Within your first few months, you'll:

  • Ship meaningful improvements to our infrastructure, reliability and developer experience
  • Take ownership of key platform areas and processes
  • Partner with product engineers to understand pain points, unblock delivery, and raise standards and improve how we operate

Preferred skills and background:

  • Strong experience with and AWS
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)
  • Experience operating and supporting the systems you build, not just shipping and moving on
  • Clear written communication. We're a distributed team, and documentation matters

It's also awesome (but not required) for you to have:

  • Experience with MongoDB, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, or Redis/Valkey
  • Familiarity with observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, etc.)
  • Experience building internal platforms or developer tools
  • Familiarity with microservices / event-driven / serverless architectures
  • Experience with networking (DNS, load balancing, VPCs, etc.)

How we work


We're a globally distributed team.

We default to asynchronous communication, keep meetings lightweight, and rely on strong written docs to stay aligned. Our core stack is , React, MongoDB, and AWS. We mainly use Jira and Slack day-to-day.

The Mixmax Story


At Mixmax, our vision is a world without busywork. Since our launch in 2015, Mixmax has become the product of choice for over 10,000 Sales and Customer Success teams to eliminate and automate repetitive work. This means more time to focus on what matters: engaging and serving the needs of customers.

We're extraordinarily proud of the company we've built. We're a driven, passionate, responsible group that values personal and professional growth equally. We take care of ourselves, our families, our customers, and one another. We believe in sustainable and diverse approaches to work and life, because optimizing for the long-term is the best path to success.

Our company is globally distributed, with remote team members worldwide. We offer competitive salaries, meaningful equity, and generous benefits. And with Mixmax, you get to work on a product people love.

Why Mixmax?

  • We're a product-led company with strong product–market fit, ambitious new AI initiatives, and a clear mission
  • You'll join at a pivotal moment - shaping the next generation of our platform and helping define how Mixmax scales technically and culturally.
  • You'll work in a team that values ownership, creativity, and building things that matter, where good ideas can come from anywhere.
  • You'll have autonomy, trust, and direct access to leadership, with the support to explore high-leverage opportunities and make real impact.

Ready to lead and build at scale with a team that moves fast and cares deeply? We'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Manager, Ticketing Customer Relations
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Ticketing Customer Relations Senior Manager is responsible for supporting the definition and implementation of the comprehensive Ticketing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) strategy in close collaboration with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management. Serving as the primary liaison in the host country, this role oversees the entire Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country, providing mentorship and direction and ensuring that all managers and staff meet established objectives throughout the project lifecycle.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reporting operationally to the Team Lead Ticketing CRM, acting as the primary Ticketing CRM liaison in the Host Country with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout the project.
  • Overseeing and managing the performance of the Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country through the implementation of effective processes, KPIs, service levels, escalation paths, and quality‑assurance plans.
  • Coordinating with other ticketing teams and FIFA functional areas to ensure cohesive and effective project delivery.
  • Handling all types of escalations with a solution‑oriented approach, ensuring efficient resolution of complex cases while keeping FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management informed.
  • Leading the identification, mitigation, and resolution of risks and issues and responding to major customer‑impacting incidents to minimise operational impact and reputational risk.
  • Ensuring the effective delivery of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy, including ticketing rules, policies, procedures, pricing, and ticket products, in line with legal requirements and ticketing objectives, ensuring fair and transparent access to tickets for as many fans as possible.
  • Overseeing sales data and demographic analysis to support the ongoing refinement of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy.
  • Translating the overall Ticketing Strategy into clear, actionable requirements that guide delivery across all Ticketing CRM functional areas.
  • Ensuring an efficient and optimised customer experience by defining and implementing the end‑to‑end customer journey for both general public and group sales customers, identifying service gaps, and implementing improvements across all channels.
  • Planning and implementing effective customer care for all ticketing customers, including organising and implementing automated customer‑care solutions for general public customers and ensuring high‑quality one‑to‑one support for both general public and group sales customers.
  • Ensuring full compliance with data protection laws, ticketing rules, terms, legal requirements, and internal policies, including the enforcement of internal control measures and access‑control policies.
  • Managing RFPs and service provider relationships to ensure external partners are contracted in a timely manner and meet all obligations related to service quality, processes, and customer data.
  • Overseeing Ticketing CRM reporting on customer care performance and trends, using data insights to enhance proactive communication and improve the overall customer experience.
  • Planning and delivering all ticketing sales collaterals and communications, and overseeing customer communications by planning, approving, and coordinating emails, notifications, content, FAQs, and manuals, ensuring mandatory legal documents are accurately presented and that tone and accuracy are consistently maintained, while ensuring proactive communication reduces the need for one‑to‑one support.
  • Ensuring the effective gathering of requirements for ticketing systems and communication channels and overseeing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to guarantee system performance and readiness.
  • Ensuring effective communication channels for proactive communication and customer care for both general public and group sales customers.

YOUR PROFILE


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record in large scale customer relations management within complex, high‑volume ticketing or major event environments; demonstrates strong leadership capabilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast‑paced, multicultural, and highly regulated environment.

Key requirements include:

  • Significant experience in customer service or ticketing operations within sports organisations or other high‑volume environments.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritise, plan, and deliver under pressure and within tight timelines.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams and external stakeholders, including headquarters‑level entities, service providers, and technical teams.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

The ideal candidate will bring experience in some of the following areas:

  • Expertise in defining CRM strategies, customer journeys, and service delivery frameworks to optimise the end‑to‑end customer experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve complex customer issues and coordinate cross‑functional responses to high‑impact incidents.
  • Solid understanding of data protection requirements and internal accountability processes to ensure full compliance with legal and operational standards.
  • Proficiency in managing RFPs and service‑provider relationships.
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret performance trends and translate data insights into actionable operational improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to oversee customer‑facing content, ensure accuracy and consistency, and support proactive communication strategies.
  • Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise and deliver complex workstreams within tight timelines.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders, demonstrating cultural awareness and high levels of discretion.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems, CRM platforms, communication channels, and User Acceptance Testing processes.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

title: RJ - Consultor Comercial Sr
description:
Estamos buscando profissionais para fazer parte da nossa equipe que desempenhará as seguintes atividades:

  • Visitar e negociar fretes com clientes de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas.
  • Elaborar tabelas de fretes de acordo com cada cliente e prestar informações referente aos carregamentos, pendências, faltas, avarias e sobras, de forma personalizada ao cliente.
  • Organizar o roteiro das visitas.
  • Escolher os clientes pelo cronograma de atendimento, verificar se o perfil da carga está adequado ao serviço prestado pela Panex, visitar aqueles que não têm tido contato há mais tempo ou que apresentam problemas, assim como clientes potenciais.
  • Procurar sempre agendar visitas em clientes próximos, da mesma rota, para otimizar tempo e combustível.
  • Apresentar novos roteiros, novidades e facilidades que a Panex oferece para os clientes.
  • Desenvolver junto aos clientes atendidos operações de transporte e logística a fim de implementar boas práticas e ampliação de negócios.
  • Realizar relatório de visitas e passar para o Gerente Comercial/Operacional.

,

  • Desejável técnico ou graduação em andamento
  • Experiência na área de vendas

  • Ter carteira de clientes será um diferencial
